message: This has a lot of high-throughput event triggers, make it a scheduled task for 12am every day.
text:
Notes Improver is now a scheduled task at 00:00 every day (`notes_improver`, change c5.0). It still reads its gate and rejection events at each run, rather than waking on each one, and it remains unconfirmed, so it does not run until you confirm it.

Its time zone is still unset. Which zone should 12am be in? Until you say, it runs on the host's clock.

steps: 1. Once a day at its scheduled time, read the Notes Files stock and how many notes files were added in the last day.
2. Compare with the previous days and decide whether one change could raise the daily count.
3. If so, propose it to the owner for approval; once approved, hand it to the Coordinator as work with the Notes Files stock as its measure.
